a: Spoofing is pretending to be something or someone else.
Tampering is unauthorized modification of data or code.
Repudiation is denying actions without adequate proof.
Information disclosure is exposing data to unauthorized parties.
Denial of service makes a system unavailable.
Elevation of privilege gains unauthorized higher rights.
Abuse cases describe how features can be misused.
Default configurations should be safe out of the box.
Systems should fail in a secure state when possible.
Diverse controls reduce shared failure modes.
